PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
 

Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of 
PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
 

About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
 

Your Mission: as a 
PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
 

 
 

Your Responsibilities:
 

Compliance & Conformity Management
 
 

• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation. 

• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects. 

• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables. 

• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities. 

• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.  

Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
 
 

• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes. 

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers. 

• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths. 

• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.  

Operational Readiness & License to Operate
 
 

• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution. 

• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation. 

• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks. 

• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and operational release. 

Education & Experience
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline. 

• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects. 

• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management. 

• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset. 

• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.  

Knowledge & Affinity
 

You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
 
 

• European product legislation and conformity assessment; 

• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles; 

• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF); 

• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness; 

• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements; 

• Occupational safety and statutory inspections; 

• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.  

Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
 

Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
 

Competences
 
 

• Translate complexity into structure and action. 

• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders. 

• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities. 

• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills. 

• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery. 

• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.  

Languages
 
 

• Dutch: Fluent 

• English: Professional proficiency 

• French: Strong asset  

You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

Satellit is seeking an experienced .NET developer with Java know-how to join a multi-disciplinary team delivering digital identity and authentication capabilities for a major energy-sector engagement. The role involves building, validating and documenting reusable authentication/authorization components, contributing to deployment automation, collaborating with IT stakeholders, and participating in agile squad activities. This position follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of being on-site about two days per week and is planned to start in the mid-October to mid-November timeframe. Full-time commitment is required.
Who are you?

Skills & competences:

• Autonomy

• Teamwork

• Presentation skills

• Communication

• Continuous learning

• Technical documentation

• Analytical problem solving

• Resilience

• Versatility and adaptability

• Continuous integration and deployment practices

• Agile methodologies and Scrum

What will you do?

• Design, implement, unit-test and document libraries, services or components that handle user authentication and authorization.

• Create example applications and code samples to illustrate how to integrate identity and access services into new or existing systems, and communicate these to engineering teams.

• Customize and extend commercial or open-source products (for example access managers, authorization engines, API gateways, reverse proxies and directory services) and produce supporting documentation for those extensions.

• Improve and automate continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows, including configuration and release automation.

• Work closely with IT and application teams to identify integration points, diagnose issues, and resolve problems when connecting to identity Fabric services.

• Install and configure third-party and open-source components by following technical guides and producing any required deployment notes.

• Take part in squad sprint activities, including planning, execution and retrospective work.

• Own assigned backlog items, drive tasks to completion and report progress to the squad.

• Prepare for and actively participate in meetings and workshops, tracking actions and follow-ups.

• Propose technical solutions that align with requirements and constraints, present them to stakeholders and refine based on feedback.

• Continuously acquire new technical knowledge, standards and tooling needed to fulfill assigned work.

• Proven experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem in a production environment.

• Practical knowledge of Java and familiarity with interoperation between Java and .NET components.

• Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with JSON and YAML configurations.

• Hands-on skills with front-end technologies such as JavaScript and frameworks like Vue.js or Blazor.

• Understanding of directory services and authentication protocols (LDAP, OAuth2, OpenID Connect).

• Solid grasp of web security fundamentals including HTTPS, cookies, CORS, single sign-on and multifactor concepts.

• Familiarity with cryptographic basics including symmetric and asymmetric key usage, hashing and keystore concepts.

• Experience deploying and operating containerized applications and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes (experience with managed clusters a plus).

• Comfortable using GIT and participating in DevOps practices for source control and delivery pipelines.

• Nice-to-have: TypeScript, PowerShell, Bash scripting, React, SAML2, PKI experience, and familiarity with identity provider solutions (for example Keycloak, Ping, Okta, ADFS, or cloud identity services).

• Experience designing or operating MicroServices-based systems is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal and soft skills: pragmatic problem-solving, autonomy, adaptability, resilience, clear communication, analytical thinking, and the ability to document and present technical work.

• Language requirements: good command of Dutch and/or French, plus English for technical collaboration.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect to contribute to the ongoing evolution of its wealth management platform (Gwp - Gambit Wealth Platform).

The Solution Architect will play a key role in ensuring architectural consistency, technical governance and alignment across multiple development squads.

The main objective is to simplify and optimise the existing architecture while improving the platform's maintainability, scalability and autonomy.
Key responsibilities

• Ensure architectural consistency and alignment across multiple development squads

• Lead and facilitate Architecture Chapter meetings, promoting technical standards and best practices

• Support Technical Leads and development teams in making architectural decisions

• Analyse the existing architecture and identify opportunities to improve maintainability, performance and scalability

• Rationalise and consolidate MicroServices to reduce technical complexity and simplify operations, hosting, testing and integration

• Design, simplify and standardise APIs and integration mechanisms

• Document architectural decisions, evaluate technical alternatives and identify potential trade-offs

• Collaborate closely with developers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts and business stakeholders

• Reduce external dependencies and improve the platform's technical and functional autonomy

• Contribute to the continuous improvement and long-term evolution of the Gwp platform

Technical environment

• Backend development:

• C# / .NET Core

• Entity Framework

• MicroServices architecture

• Architecture & API design:

• REST APIs / OpenAPI

• Asyncapi / Typespec

• ArchiMate / UML

• Enterprise Architect

• Cloud & DevOps:

• Microsoft Azure DevOps

• Docker / Kubernetes

• Helm

• CI/CD

• Data & messaging:

• PostgreSQL

• Apache Kafka

• Testing:NUnit / xUnit

Ideal candidate

We are looking for a hands-on, pragmatic and technically strong Solution Architect who can combine architectural vision with a deep understanding of software development.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with multiple squads, challenging existing architectural decisions and driving improvements across a complex software platform.

This is a cross-functional Solution Architect position, not simply a senior .NET developer or technical lead role.

• Strong experience in software development within the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, ideally 10+ years

• Proven experience as a Solution Architect, ideally 3-5 years or more

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, MicroServices and API architecture

• Experience in analysing, simplifying and modernising complex existing architectures

• Good knowledge of containerisation, DevOps practices and cloud environments

• Ability to challenge technical decisions and propose pragmatic, scalable and maintainable solutions

• Experience working across multiple development teams or squads

• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to balance technical requirements, business needs and long-term architectural objectives

• Fluent in French and English (both required)

 

Nice to have

• Experience with architectural governance and Architecture Chapters

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture methodologies and modelling tools

jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - PHP / JavaScript Developer
jobs.description:

The platform handles high volumes of sensitive data, integrates with multiple external systems, and operates in a highly available production environment.
Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications across the full technology stack.

• Develop and integrate REST APIs.

• Maintain and evolve complex legacy applications while ensuring stability and service continuity.

• Contribute to the migration from legacy technologies (PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, AngularJS, JQuery) towards a modern stack based on PHP 8.2+, Laravel, and Vue.js.

• Improve application architecture, code quality, security, and maintainability.

• Participate in technical analysis, troubleshooting, code reviews, testing, and documentation.

• Collaborate closely with developers, analysts, UX/UI specialists, and project stakeholders within an Agile environment.

Additional information

• Professional English required.

• Long-term assignment with renewable contracts.

• Up to 3 days of remote work per week.

• Occasional on-site visits to operational environments and end users.

• Opportunity to work on applications with direct business impact and visibility.

• Strong experience with PHP and modern JavaScript.

• Solid knowledge of a modern PHP framework (Laravel preferred, Symfony also welcomed).

• Experience with a modern frontend framework (Vue.js is a plus).

• Comfortable working across both backend and frontend development.

• Strong understanding of SQL, REST APIs, GIT, and software development best practices.

• Proven experience maintaining and modernizing legacy applications in production environments.

• Ability to identify and remediate security issues in existing codebases.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Technical environment:

• Current stack: PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, Smarty, AngularJS, JQuery

• Target stack: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12+, Vue 3, JavaScript

• CI/CD: Modern CI/CD practices and tools

Nice to have:

• Experience with Laravel and/or Vue.js.

• Background in application modernization and legacy migration projects.

• Knowledge of application security best practices.

• Experience working on high-availability or mission-critical systems.

• Exposure to Symfony, React, Angular, or similar technologies.

jobs.description:

•   
Handling inbound and outbound freight trucks with precision to guarantee damage-free logistics handling.
    
•

Maintaining clean aisles, adhering strictly to occupational safety protocols, and conducting daily pre-shift reach truck checks.
   
  
•

•   
Fluent communication skills in English (working knowledge of Dutch is an asset) to ensure safety on the work floor and clear team communication.
    
•

•   
You are available for a 2-shift rotation or a fixed night shift and align with our collective closure schedule (3 weeks in late July/early August and the Christmas/New Year holiday period).

jobs.occupation: Senior Key Account Manager / Business Development Manager Biometrics
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
   
• Identify, develop and win new strategic accounts within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, building relationships from initial prospecting through to contract award.  
• Own and develop a portfolio of key accounts, establishing account strategies, identifying growth opportunities and increasing share of wallet.  
• Build and maintain strong, multi-level relationships with key decision-makers, including Clinical Operations, Biometrics, Data Management, Statistics, Procurement and R&D stakeholders.  
• Develop a deep understanding of customer strategies, pipelines and outsourcing models to anticipate needs and position relevant SGS solutions proactively.  
• Drive new opportunities and expansion within existing accounts,  
• Lead strategic customer engagements, RFPs, negotiations and commercial discussions through to successful contract closure.  
• Develop and execute account plans and business development strategies, including target identification, opportunity qualification, pipeline development and revenue forecasting.  
• Actively build your network through industry events, conferences, professional networks and targeted business development activities.  
• Work closely with internal Clinical Research, Biometrics and commercial teams to develop tailored solutions and competitive value propositions.  
• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring customer priorities are understood and reflected in proposals, delivery models and commercial strategies.  
• Establish strong internal stakeholder relationships and coordinate cross-functional teams around strategic opportunities and key accounts.  
• Maintain a high level of market intelligence, including competitor activity, outsourcing trends, pricing and customer priorities.  
• Ensure accurate and proactive management of opportunities, account plans and customer intelligence in the CRM system.  
• Contribute to the development of the Biometrics commercial strategy and identify new market segments, services and partnership opportunities. 

Your profile
   
• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Life Sciences, Business or an equivalent field.  
• You have 8+ years of relevant commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research or CRO industry, ideally combining new business development and strategic account management.  
• You have a proven track record of winning new business and growing strategic accounts, preferably within CRO, Biometrics, Data Management, Biostatistics or related clinical development services.  
• You have a strong understanding of the clinical drug development process and the role of Biometrics throughout clinical development.  
• You are commercially driven and comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across Clinical Operations, Biometrics, R&D, Procurement and executive management.  
• You have demonstrated experience managing complex sales cycles, strategic RFPs, negotiations and multi-stakeholder decision processes.  
• You are a strong hunter and relationship builder, able to open new accounts while developing long-term strategic partnerships.  
• You combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to prospecting, opportunity development and account execution.  
• You are highly networked within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry and comfortable representing the organization at conferences and industry events.  
• You have excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.  
• You are fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

No two days will be quite the same. You'll combine day-to-day HR responsibilities with practical health, safety and well-being coordination. 

HR – People & Organisation 
 
· Manage recruitment, interviews and onboarding of new colleagues.
 
· Coordinate payroll, absences, contracts and personnel administration.
 
· Be the first point of contact for employees' HR questions.
 
· Organise training and keep employee records up to date.
 
· Help improve HR processes as the team grows.
 
EHS – Health, Safety & Well-being
 
· Coordinate workplace safety and well-being activities with external prevention specialists.
 
· Follow up on safety procedures, risk assessments and preventive actions.
 
· Organise safety inductions, mandatory training and occupational health appointments.
 
· Maintain EHS documentation and follow up on workplace incidents.
 
· Help create a safe, well-organised working environment.
 
You won't be expected to be an EHS expert from day one. Your organisational skills, initiative and willingness to learn are what matter most.
 
 

· A Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in HR or a related field. 

· Around 3 years of relevant HR experience, ideally combining administration, payroll support and recruitment.
 
· A working knowledge of Belgian HR administration and employment legislation.
 
· Excellent English, essential for communication with international colleagues.
 
· French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
 
· A practical, organised and independent approach.
 
· An interest in workplace safety and well-being.
 
Above all, you're someone who takes initiative, enjoys helping colleagues and feels comfortable in a small, fast-moving team.
 
Work authorisation: Applicants must currently reside in Belgium and already have the legal right to work in Belgium. Please note that visa or work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.
